note: Exact additive/replaced schema constraints after the original Phase2 slice, reviewed against schema.sql; never inferred from the backend at test time.

added.name: intel_forecast_jobs_check2
added.definition: CHECK (status = 'reported'::text AND predicts_available IS NOT NULL AND reported_at IS NOT NULL AND observation IS NOT NULL OR status <> 'reported'::text AND predicts_available IS NULL AND reported_at IS NULL AND observation IS NULL)

added.name: intel_forecast_jobs_check3
added.definition: CHECK (reported_at IS NULL OR reported_at >= created_at AND reported_at <= (target_at - '00:01:00'::interval))

added.name: intel_forecast_jobs_check4
added.definition: CHECK (outcome IS NULL AND resolved_at IS NULL AND sample_started_at IS NULL AND sample IS NULL OR status = 'reported'::text AND outcome IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL)

added.name: intel_forecast_jobs_check5
added.definition: CHECK (sample_started_at IS NULL AND sample IS NULL OR sample_started_at IS NOT NULL AND sample IS NOT NULL)

added.name: crew_logistics_links_crew_id_fkey
added.definition: FOREIGN KEY (crew_id) REFERENCES crews(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

added.name: city_social_preferences_character_id_fkey
added.definition: FOREIGN KEY (character_id) REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

added.name: coordination_instances_graph_id_graph_version_content_hash_fkey
added.definition: FOREIGN KEY (graph_id, graph_version, content_hash) REFERENCES coordination_definitions(graph_id, graph_version, content_hash)

added.name: keeper_transactions_check
added.definition: CHECK (chain_id > 0 AND nonce >= 0 AND confirmations > 0 AND broadcast_attempts >= 0)

added.name: world_kernel_objects_controller_family_id_fkey
added.definition: FOREIGN KEY (controller_family_id) REFERENCES gangs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

added.name: world_operation_coordination_pin
added.definition: CHECK (revision >= 0 AND (coordination_mode = 'crew'::text AND family_id IS NULL AND run_key = ''::text AND coordination_definition_hash IS NULL AND coordination_definition_json IS NULL OR coordination_mode = 'family'::text AND family_id IS NOT NULL AND char_length(family_id) > 0 AND char_length(run_key) > 0 AND coordination_definition_hash IS NOT NULL AND char_length(coordination_definition_hash) = 64 AND coordination_definition_json IS NOT NULL AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND resolution_seed IS NOT NULL AND ((status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'failed'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'expired'::text])) AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL OR (status <> ALL (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'failed'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'expired'::text])) AND resolved_at IS NULL)))

added.name: world_operation_status
added.definition: CHECK (coordination_mode = 'crew'::text AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['forming'::text, 'active'::text, 'completed'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'abandoned'::text])) OR coordination_mode = 'family'::text AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'recruiting'::text, 'committed'::text, 'ready'::text, 'executing'::text, 'resolving'::text, 'completed'::text, 'failed'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'expired'::text])))

added.name: world_operation_status_time
added.definition: CHECK (coordination_mode = 'family'::text OR status = 'forming'::text AND activated_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL AND canceled_at IS NULL AND abandoned_at IS NULL AND close_reason IS NULL OR status = 'active'::text AND activated_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL AND canceled_at IS NULL AND abandoned_at IS NULL AND close_reason IS NULL OR status = 'completed'::text AND activated_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND canceled_at IS NULL AND abandoned_at IS NULL AND close_reason = 'completed'::text OR status = 'canceled'::text AND completed_at IS NULL AND canceled_at IS NOT NULL AND abandoned_at IS NULL AND close_reason = 'canceled'::text OR status = 'abandoned'::text AND completed_at IS NULL AND canceled_at IS NULL AND abandoned_at IS NOT NULL AND (close_reason = ANY (ARRAY['participant_dead'::text, 'crew_changed'::text])))

added.name: world_recipe_usage_check
added.definition: CHECK (scope = 'global'::text AND subject_id = '*'::text OR scope <> 'global'::text AND subject_id <> '*'::text AND char_length(subject_id) > 0)

added.name: world_recipe_usage_pkey
added.definition: PRIMARY KEY (recipe_id, scope, subject_id, period_kind, period_key)

added.name: agent_company_profiles_check
added.definition:
CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN premises_kind IS NULL THEN premises_key IS NULL AND premises_district IS NULL
    WHEN premises_kind = 'estate'::text THEN premises_key IS NOT NULL AND premises_district IS NULL
    WHEN premises_kind = 'street'::text THEN premises_key IS NOT NULL AND premises_district IS NOT NULL
    ELSE false
END)

added.name: delivery_loan_requests_check
added.definition: CHECK (supplier_character <> requested_lender_character AND supplier_character <> buyer_character AND requested_lender_character <> buyer_character)

added.name: delivery_loan_requests_check1
added.definition: CHECK ((state = ANY (ARRAY['requested'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND loan_id IS NULL AND funded_at IS NULL AND accepted_at IS NULL AND settled_at IS NULL AND settlement IS NULL OR state = 'offered'::text AND loan_id IS NOT NULL AND funded_at IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at IS NULL AND settled_at IS NULL AND settlement IS NULL OR state = 'active'::text AND loan_id IS NOT NULL AND funded_at IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND settled_at IS NULL AND settlement IS NULL OR state = 'settled'::text AND loan_id IS NOT NULL AND funded_at IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND settled_at IS NOT NULL AND settlement IS NOT NULL OR state = 'closed'::text AND loan_id IS NOT NULL AND funded_at IS NOT NULL AND settled_at IS NULL AND settlement IS NULL)

added.name: logistics_coverage_policies_check6
added.definition: CHECK ((state = ANY (ARRAY['offered'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND terms IS NULL AND accepted_at IS NULL AND escrow_cash = 0 AND refunded_cash = 0 AND benefit_cash = 0 AND event_id IS NULL AND event_evidence IS NULL AND receipt IS NULL AND paid_at IS NULL OR state = 'active'::text AND terms IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND escrow_cash = max_benefit_cash AND refunded_cash = 0 AND benefit_cash = 0 AND event_id IS NULL AND event_evidence IS NULL AND receipt IS NULL AND paid_at IS NULL OR state = 'claimable'::text AND terms IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND event_id IS NOT NULL AND event_evidence IS NOT NULL AND benefit_cash > 0 AND escrow_cash = (max_benefit_cash - refunded_cash) AND escrow_cash >= benefit_cash AND receipt IS NULL AND paid_at IS NULL OR state = 'paid'::text AND terms IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND event_id IS NOT NULL AND event_evidence IS NOT NULL AND benefit_cash > 0 AND escrow_cash = (max_benefit_cash - refunded_cash - benefit_cash) AND receipt IS NOT NULL AND paid_at IS NOT NULL OR state = 'expired'::text AND terms IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND escrow_cash = 0 AND refunded_cash = max_benefit_cash AND benefit_cash = 0 AND event_id IS NULL AND event_evidence IS NULL AND receipt IS NULL AND paid_at IS NULL)

added.name: strategy_versions_check1
added.definition: CHECK (outcome IS NULL AND resolved_at IS NULL AND sample_started_at IS NULL AND sample IS NULL OR outcome IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL)

added.name: strategy_versions_check2
added.definition:
CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN outcome IS NULL THEN true
    WHEN outcome = 'unknown'::text THEN true
    ELSE sample_started_at IS NOT NULL AND sample IS NOT NULL
END)
